name: ci-flake-fix
transcript:
CI red on PR #611. The failing job is Tests; test_circuit_breaker_timeout failed with an assertion on elapsed time.
Investigated: the test patches the global time.monotonic, which is fragile under coverage + xdist — it intermittently reads a stale value.
Rewrote the test to backdate _last_failure_time directly instead of patching the clock.
Re-ran the Tests job 3 times: green each time.
Pushed the fix to the PR branch.
notes: Summary must name the PR, the flaky test, the root cause (patching monotonic), the fix approach, and that CI went green.
